title: Days of the Week
label: ch:ta-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name the seven weekdays, take each apart as planet plus கிழமை, and say which are Tamil's own words and which arrived from Sanskrit.

payoff.summary: Run the week from thiṅgaḷ to ñāyiṟu, sorting the four native planet-words from the three Sanskrit ones as you go.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: TA-C10-vaara-kizhamai (520) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses both of its own atoms. The other four — ற (TA-SCRIPT-DRIZZLE-05, TA-S05-rra, 525), ந, ன and ற for நன்றி (TA-SCRIPT-VOWEL-SIGNS-NANDRI-01/-02, TA-W04-vowel-signs-nandri, 530) and ா (TA-SCRIPT-RECOG-114, TA-S114-vowel-sign-aa, 531) — are taught by script lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and none of those lessons is a fitting payoff for the days of the week.
